useEditLease (web/src/hooks/useEditLease.ts) is NOT in the native parity manifest and is unavailable on React Native: the web hook elects an edit-lease owner across browser tabs over the BroadcastChannel-backed lib/broadcast bus (localStorage storage-event fallback). RN is a single app instance with no BroadcastChannel, no localStorage storage events, and no peer tabs, so the cross-tab transport is structurally unavailable. The inlined native hook returns the SAME stable no-conflict snapshot the web hook itself returns from its documented opt-out branch ({ isOwner: false, otherTab: null, claim: noop }); claim() is a no-op (no previous owner to yield).
